reference: Existing authenticated measured ABI3 CAPOFF capture; no new reference or variance repeat
execution: Production private worker, same whole-resume IPC, same 439 resumes and six selected Q cuts, native resume snapshots preserved

windows.profileStart: After native creation, during startup before parent ready/executionCPU
windows.profileStop: Diagnostic finish message after executionCPU captured, before terminal settlement
windows.cpu: Original process.cpuUsage execution window across parent and worker threads; diagnostic profile setup/stop outside it

overlap: Inclusive and nested buckets overlap; instrumentation and profile overhead affect execution. Not another performance gate.
ipcResidual: Factory resume roundtrip minus worker resume processing-to-ready includes queue/transport/enqueue/parent delivery; never claim pure transport.
guardEffects: Exact inverse derivations retain original guards/effects and original callback loops. Diagnostic finalize performs no board/native callbacks.
